title: Zk Regulatory Compliance Mixer
tagline: Harmonizing Blockchain Anonymity with Regulatory Compliance
description:
ZK Crypto Mixer, is revolutionizing blockchain transaction privacy. It masterfully obscures the origins and destinations of digital assets, ensuring utmost confidentiality. While similar tools like Tornado Cash have struggled with misuse leading to innocent users' challenges, our mixer confronts these issues head-on.

Privacy and Security: It safeguards user privacy and protects business transactions, maintaining anonymity and resisting surveillance.
Addressing Misuse: Tackles the misuse by malicious actors, preventing money laundering and other illicit activities.
Navigating Regulatory Waters: Balances privacy needs with regulatory compliance, addressing concerns around unknown transaction associations.
Our innovative approach involves Associative Set Providers (ASPs), where users belong to specific groups, enhancing privacy while holding malicious actors accountable. This system cleverly balances privacy with the need to avoid appearing suspicious, offering flexibility and control in managing transaction privacy.

Equilibria Mixer's infrastructure spans various components, including Blockchain for smart contracts, Backend for ASP APIs, a ZK-circuit, and a user-friendly Frontend. Our integration with Anon Aadhar, Ethereum Attestation Service, and The Graph further strengthens our offering. Deployed on multiple test networks like Scroll, Base, Arbitrum, and others, Equilibria Mixer sets a new standard in privacy-preserving blockchain transactions.
